title: Megurine Luka — Sharing My Shine〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four... Five, six, seven, eight...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thanks for pushing my back for me, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
Now, let's switch.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Owwwww! MEIKO, try to be more gentle!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, I will do. But you still need to stretch well to prevent getting hurt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just look at KAITO. He's trying his best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Owwwww...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You can do it, KAITO!
You've become a lot more flexible compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
You never could bend down this far!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, he has been stretching in secret.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha. I didn't want to look bad in front of Minori or the others since they've been working so hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hear that? So, Rin, you need to also try your best♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You never know. The other versions of us could be watching us right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, I got it...!
I'll try a little harder!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, it's kinda weird to think how there are other versions of us out there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is it? Each SEKAI is born out of people's feelings, so it doesn't seem like too big of a leap to think that our counterparts won't be the same as us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, like the other Luka and Miku I saw that time, you're saying that there could be more of them and us out there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means there's a me that's not me, a me that's neither me nor that me, a me that's neither me nor that me nor the other me out there and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So there's you, Luka, a you that's not you, a you that's neither you nor the other you and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Uhh... I'm starting to lose track...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More simply, there are lots of versions of us out there♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That is much simpler.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're so lucky.
I wish I had a chance to meet one of my other selves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I guess the odds of that happening are fairly low...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I don't think it's that unlikely.
After all, it's happened to Rin and me already.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, if we're lucky...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, rather...
If our feelings were to coalesce around the same thought, then...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So if we all feel the same thing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think that's our ticket.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially since my other self said she's also been watching over the girls.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we all feel the same way about them, so I do suppose it's not out of the question for our hearts to converge like that again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, that's something for us to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, now that we're all done stretching, shall we begin practicing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! We have to practice for our show!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I wonder if she's watching us now.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We promise to make our show a good one not just for the girls, but also for you.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (So, I hope you'll keep watching over us.)
